create_minigridhack_env: create a MiniGridHack environment by wrapping a gym-minigrid env with NetHack rendering and navigation
create_multiroom_env: create a MiniHack multi-room navigation environment with N2, N4, N6, or N10 room variants
create_locked_door_env: create a MiniHack multi-room environment with locked doors requiring kick or open actions
create_lava_monster_env: create a MiniHack multi-room environment with lava walls and configurable monster counts
create_lavacrossing_env: create a MiniHack LavaCrossing or SimpleCrossing navigation environment with configurable crossings
